subject: Signoff path and comp exception request for Morgan Lee (Sr. Inference Engineer)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Comp exception request — Morgan Lee (Sr. Inference Eng)

Hi team,

Following the onsite loop last week, the interview panel and I recommend we extend an offer to Morgan Lee for the Sr. Inference Engineer role. Morgan is a strong fit for runtime performance and kernel-level optimization work — panel notes attached.

Request: approval for a comp exception above band (Band: IC3) to land at base $250,000 + 15% target bonus, with a small sign-on of $30k (prorated) to offset counteroffer risk. This is ~12% above our published midpoint for IC3 in SF.

Rationale (short):
- Candidate brings 8+ years shipping inference kernels and a strong NVidia/ML compiler background.
- Comp market for specialized inference runtime talent is above normal banding; attached benchmark (market_benchmark_q3_2026.xlsx).
- Hiring manager (Dylan) confirms an immediate roadmap impact: kernel refactor and perf tuning on two active customer projects.

Attachments: comp_exception_request_lee_20260927.pdf, market_benchmark_q3_2026.xlsx, morgan_lee_resume.pdf

Asking for: written signoff (reply-all) from Neha (comp), Lauren (people lead), and finance OK from Markus by EOD Wednesday (2026-09-29) so we can freeze offer terms and start DocuSign.

Next steps: if approved, I will draft the offer (link to draft here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcQ-offer-terms-morgan-lee) and circulate to legal/finance for final review.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Comp exception request — Morgan Lee (Sr. Inference Eng)

Thanks Marissa — good write-up. A couple of quick asks before I greenlight:

1) Please add a short leveling note: why IC3 vs IC4 given the ask. (Dylan, can you provide specific expected scope and Mgr/IC expectations?)
2) Confirm total on-target comp (OTC) and cash first-year (base + sign-on + any prorated bonus).

I also want to understand retention levers: are we proposing any milestone-based RSU vesting tweaks to mitigate higher cash? If not, note why.

Happy to sign off once Neha confirms comp plan benchmarking and Markus confirms budget impact.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, People Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Comp exception request — Morgan Lee (Sr. Inference Eng)

Quick comp analysis attached — summary here:
- Market comps (SF, specialized inference) suggest a 90th percentile cash of ~$245–255k for candidates with Morgan's profile.
- Proposed: base $250k, 15% target bonus = OTC $287.5k, first-year cash (base + sign-on) ~$280k.
- IC level: I agree Morgan maps to IC3 given individual contributor scope and lack of direct people management; the expectation is strong technical leadership but not org management. IC4 would be for cross-org technical leads.

Recommendation: approve one-time exception to base to $250k and $30k sign-on. No changes to standard equity plan (standard RSU grant for IC3). Instead, add a 6–month retention cliff on the sign-on and a 12-month performance milestone tied to product impact for accelerated vesting — helps mitigate risk.

I will route the formal comp exception form to Markus for budget sign-off once Lauren confirms leveling language.

Neha Kapoor
Compensation & Benefits | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T12:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Comp exception request — Morgan Lee (Sr. Inference Eng)

Reviewed the proposed numbers. Finance can cover the incremental cash within Q4 hiring budget provided recruiting confirms headcount bucket and start window (before 11/30).

Conditions for signoff from Finance:
- Confirm start date window (Dylan please confirm).
- Sign-on pay schedule (prorated over first 30 days or lump sum) — prefer prorated unless recruiting flags counter-offer risk.
- DocuSign envelope should include standard termination/repayment language for sign-on if employee leaves within 6 months.

I will sign the comp exception form once Neha publishes it and the above are confirmed.

-Markus
CFO | Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T07:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Comp exception request — Morgan Lee (Sr. Inference Eng)

Start window: target start 2026-11-08 to allow relocation and overlap with release cadence.
Sign-on: prefer lump-sum to reduce counteroffer risk; can do prorated if recruiting pushes back.
Leveling: Morgan will own kernel optimization across two product teams (Inference Runtime and Serving); this is substantial cross-team technical leadership but without direct reports — IC3 fits.

Please proceed with Neha's form and Markus' budget conditionals. Happy to jump on a quick sync if needed.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Manager, Inference | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Comp exception request — Morgan Lee (Sr. Inference Eng)

Thanks everyone for the fast turn. I approve the compensation exception as proposed: base $250k, 15% target bonus, $30k sign-on with a 6-month repayment clause and the performance milestone language Neha suggested.

Markus: please confirm in the comp exception form that finance notes the start-window condition; otherwise we are good to route to offer.

Marissa: please move forward to prepare the offer, include lump-sum sign-on unless recruiting advises otherwise, and send to Morgan with copy to Atalia (recruiter). Use DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123-LEE-OFFER.

I will mark as approved in Greenhouse after the signed DocuSign is returned.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Product | Redwood Inference
